about_the_game:
An Army of mercenaries with advanced weaponry is marching across the globe! You must find the one responsible and stop them! You must dodge, and cut!, hazards as you advance through various terrain. Cross the platforms over pitfalls and collect coins as you move through the level!

Super Dragon Ninja is a simple but challenging game. Lasers move quickly but so do you! The objective is to dodge the hazards and move across the platforms to get to the end of the level. Level timers keep track of your best times! You can spend your hard earned coins in the store for decorations! Then you can use them to decorate your home on the main menu. Through the fishing sign are minigames to play! With 24 kinds of fish to catch and collect, display your favorites in your home! Other games track High scores and award coins!

-Dev Notes-

Hi! I am a Learning solo indie dev and this is my first game! It's just a simple game but I wanted to publish it to learn and set everything up. That said I want to make it the best it can be. So if it doesn't look great or it's too short I plan to support it and do lots of updates! I also wanted to publish it because I would like your feedback! It would be very important in making the game better. I am confident in making 2D games now and hope to make more soon, I have more games planned! Your support means a lot, thank you.

-Sean

Levels - The game is still too short but I plan to add more levels! I would like to know if people think levels are too long or too short. Are they too easy? too hard? Any Level Mechanics that you liked or disliked?

Movement/Camera - I enjoyed the free based movement and camera but I could learn how to change to grid based movement and a middle stationary camera if its unenjoyable. Tried to make the hitboxes and platforms forgiving to compensate. Endless mode has a fixed camera to try.

Minigames - Added Minigames in the fishing sign. I am heavily inspired by old games and even old flash/browser games! (Does anyone remember the Ant game?)

Updates Coming Soon! (Biweekly)

-Steam Achievements

-Update Shop and Decorations

-Special Moves and Power-ups

-More Levels

-Art/Music - I want to improve on the art and music but will keep the same big pixel resolution. 

TLDR: Lots of updates coming soon! Trailer needs to be updated!
